description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder, which constructs and processes configuration schema interchange objects for HTMLPurifier, including methods for building from directories, files, and hashes, as well as handling directives and validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and populating HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange objects from directories, files, or hashes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the varParser, defaulting to HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native if none provided.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Creates an interchange object by building from a specified directory.

methods.name: buildDir
methods.description: Builds the interchange object by reading schema files from a directory.

methods.name: buildFile
methods.description: Builds the interchange object from a specific schema file.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an interchange object based on a hash, validating presence of ID and namespace.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Creates a directive object from hash data and adds it to the interchange.

methods.name: evalArray
methods.description: Evaluates a string as a PHP array without using the array() wrapper.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Converts an array list into a lookup array with values as keys.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Creates an ID object from a string.

methods.name: _findUnused
methods.description: Triggers warnings for any hash keys that were not accessed during building, indicating potential typos or missing data.
